content: PowerShell 7 on Ubuntu 24.04 (Noble): supported by Microsoft until 2029-05-31. Preferred install: Microsoft package repository (PMC) — wget packages.microsoft.com/config/ubuntu/24.04/packages-microsoft-prod.deb, sudo dpkg -i, sudo apt-get install powershell. Alternative: universal .deb from GitHub releases (7.6.6 LTS current in doc updated 2026-08-11). Binary tar.gz method documented under install-other-linux#binary-archives (no sudo needed). Snap exists but is not a Microsoft-supported method. All primary paths require sudo.
